measurement: Held-out prompts64-127; five separately executed policies selected on development prompts0-63. Adaptive action set is restricted to {0,3,7}, with budget7 full-cost calibration. Warm state is initialized only on development prompts0-63; continuous EWMA across waves/batches/repeats.
target_domain: AWQ-calibrated symmetric W4A16 compressed-tensors; independent from BF16
readiness: Require all pinned indexed shards before launch; native AWQ kernel and draft integration unverified
route_population: Separate instrumented episode covers the same first64 workload records at every B; trace does not enter performance windows.
execution_domain_note: Compiled V1 is the primary native execution domain; chosen before these campaigns ran after the OLMoE execution comparison exposed a stronger AR baseline. Calibration and held-out evaluation stay in this same domain; compatibility failures are inspected, not filtered by performance.
